messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: `P1 - inference-eu-5xx-spike` fired for service `embeddings-serving-eu1`. Notify: @Priya Patel, @ops-sre. Alert group: 5xx-rate above 2% for 5m, downstream errors increasing. link: https://pagerduty.fake/incident/INC123456789

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC123456789 created by monitor (eu-embed-latency). Current status: triggered -> waiting for ack. Escalation policy: oncall-sre-eu.

Priya Patel: Acked. Oncall SRE here, taking it. Quick summary: 5xx spike noticed on embeddings-producing endpoint in eu1 region, started ~11:12UTC, impacting batch and realtime embed routes.

Jun Park: Thanks Priya. Are customer-facing API keys failing or just internal retries? Any 429s?

Priya Patel: Mostly 5xx (502/503) from the embedding workers. No 429s observed. Error samples show `java.io.IOException: model process crashed` in logs.

Samir Rao: I'm seeing KV-cache eviction churn in the logs around same time, high memory OOM restarts on node set eu-worker-3a. Pushing pod status: `CrashLoopBackOff` for embedder-v2 on hosts eu-worker-3a/3b.

Derek Lin: Confirmed. Running a quick tail: ```
kubectl -n inference logs embedder-v2-3a -c model --since=2m
...
E 11:12:07 model_runner.cpp:298] fatal: allocate failed for kv cache 8192
E 11:12:08 model_runner.cpp:301] backtrace...
```

Priya Patel: Impact: customer traffic showing increased errors. Early estimate: 12 active customer keys saw >20% error rate. Notifying success managers. Setting mitigation channel to eng-oncall for capacity changes.

ops-sre: @Priya any chance this is a regression from the midnight rollout? Canary passed earlier this morning.

Priya Patel: Good question. Deployment history shows `embedder-v2:2026-03-15-23` rolled at 02:30UTC. I'll roll back to `embedder-v2:2026-03-14-18` on the affected pool if we confirm. Jun, Samir can you validate rollback will revert kernel/quant changes?

Jun Park: Rollback should revert the new attention kernel and increased kv-cache default. I can stage rollback to eu-worker pool. Doing dry-run: ```
kubectl -n inference set image ds/embedder-v2 embedder-v2=registry/redwood/embedder-v2:2026-03-14-18 --selector=pool=eu1
```

Samir Rao: Before rolling back, we can try temporary scale-up of dedicated pool to drain errors: bump replicas from 6 -> 9 in eu1 to absorb cold start. Also will move large-request routing to fallback pool (us-west warm) for 2-3 mins.

Derek Lin: Scaling up now. Command: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/embedder-v2 --replicas=9 -l pool=eu1` -> started. Watch pods spawning.

Priya Patel: Routing change applied: reroute heavy batch traffic to fallback-us-west for 5m. Monitoring customer error rates.

ops-sre: Metrics: 60s after scale up, 5xx % drops from 3.1% -> 1.7% but not green. Still some crash loops.

Jun Park: I see some nodes still OOM on initial load; rollback queued if scale doesn't fully resolve in 4m. Informing support.

Samir Rao: Quick mitigation plan: 1) scale up eu pool to 9 (done) 2) reroute batch to us-west (done) 3) if errors persist, rollback to previous image (queued) 4) follow-up: debug KV allocation params and add guard.

Priya Patel: Rolling back now on eu-worker pool (staged). Command executed. I'll monitor pod readiness.

pagerduty-bot: INC123456789 status update: acknowledged by Priya Patel, responders assigned: Priya Patel, Jun Park, Samir Rao.

Derek Lin: Pod readiness coming up. New pods are stable on 2026-03-14-18 image. Error rate dropping.

ops-sre: 5xx down to 0.4% after rollback + scale + reroute. Customer impact window estimated 11:12UTC–11:25UTC.

Priya Patel: Closing the customer-facing incident communication: sending note to success channel: "We saw a transient 5xx spike on embeddings in EU, mitigated by rollback and autoscale; no persistent data loss; teams investigating root cause."

Jun Park: I'll open a follow-up issue with root cause hypothesis: KV-cache sizing + kernel change increased memory pressure under mixed long/short sequences. Need reproducible test, perf benchmarks.

Samir Rao: Adding postmortem owner: Jun. I'll collect logs and crash dumps: linking artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/INC123456789/

Priya Patel: Closing the PD incident in 10m if metrics stay green. Great work team. :tada:

pagerduty-bot: INC123456789 status: resolved by Priya Patel. Resolution note: rollback to prior embedder image and temporary scale adjustments resolved the spike.

Priya Patel: Quick checklist for post-incident: - run canary with memory-stress test - lower default kv-cache for new kernels - add alert for OOM restarts spike - update runbook with rollback steps and fallback routing playbook

ops-sre: Acknowledged. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Jun & Samir tomorrow to triage and assign action items.

Priya Patel: Thread closed, final note posted to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/INC123456789/postmortem
